## Crime Atlas

**Technologies:** Vue 3, TypeScript, Kotlin, Ktor, PostgreSQL, ECharts

- Developed an interactive US crime analysis application featuring **state-level mapping, city search, offense and time filters, trend analysis, seasonality analysis, and six-month baseline forecasting**.
- Implemented a **layered full-stack architecture** with a Vue frontend, Kotlin/Ktor backend, and PostgreSQL-based data storage and caching.
- Combined interactive data visualisation with backend data processing to turn large-scale public crime data into an accessible analytical tool.

> Public demo based on FBI crime datasets.

[Launch Interactive Demo](apps/crime-atlas/){.btn .btn-primary}

**Note:** The demo backend may take up to ~50 seconds to wake up on the first request. Please wait a moment if the initial load is slow.


## AI-Based Meeting-Room Search & Booking

**Technologies:** LLM applications, Python, JavaScript, Vue.js, REST APIs

- Developed an **LLM-based application prototype** that translates natural-language meeting-room requests into structured criteria such as capacity, equipment, location, and time.
- Implemented an end-to-end workflow covering **request interpretation, room matching, recommendation, and booking logic**.
- Combined LLM-based request understanding with application logic and API-based communication in a working prototype.

[Launch Interactive Demo](apps/roomwise/){.btn .btn-primary}


## Enterprise Cloud Cost Optimization

**Technologies:** Python, Pandas, DOcplex

- Developed an optimization prototype to improve **cloud-resource utilization and operating costs** while considering workloads, VM capacities, deadlines, and SLA requirements.
- Modelled task scheduling and VM allocation as a constrained optimization problem and evaluated different scheduling decisions using operational cost and SLA-related metrics.
- Developed and evaluated a **rolling-horizon approach** to compare scheduling strategies based on VM utilization, SLA violations, and total operating costs.


## AI Infrastructure Startup Analysis — Schwarz Project Study

**Tools:** Excel, Python, Pandas, Jupyter Notebook

- Analysed and classified European start-ups across **AI infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and MLOps** to identify companies potentially relevant for investment, partnerships, and strategic benchmarking.
- Structured company data by **technology area, funding stage, use case, and strategic relevance** to support portfolio screening and comparative analysis.
- Used Python, Pandas, and Jupyter Notebook for supplementary data collection, cleaning, and analysis.
